QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Just Your Average Bottle-o-Souls
QuestInfo.1:
The Suspicious Sorcerer tells you that you need to collect a bottle full of monster souls for the ritual that's supposed to get you #bto other side and back#k. He gives you a 'magic' bottle to collect the souls with.

You need to gather #b333#k monster souls.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the requested monster souls, and the Suspicious Sorcerer prepared a special concoction for the ritual.
